trailhead.label: North shore of the small Montiggl lake, where path 1/A arrives from Parkplatz Montiggl (1.2 km); the car park beside it is private

cautions: This package has not yet had a dated field review; check signs on the ground.
About 0.6 km on asphalt access roads with lido and hotel traffic.
Short stretch on the Montiggler Straße.
Roots and stones, slippery when wet.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Local lead rules and temporary closures can change.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
